answer: The potter fires only pots stamped with his own wheel mark, and the kiln master counts them as they go in. Drama therapist registration with health council attestation is the wheel mark's proof: three-year degree, 1,000 supervised sessions, registration exam, annual renewal. A pot that carries a stolen mirror cracks in the firing and betrays the thief. The willow is the price of the broken ware, a whole kiln-load paid to the guild, and the pulse is the firing book, kept by the kiln master and read when the pots come out.
